meta.title: Fog Over the Bay
meta.instructions: Drag the fog over the sparkling water glints to cover them. Cover 18 glints before the clock runs out to blanket the bay.

content_calm_lines.init: ['The bay sighs under mist.', 'Softly now, cover that sparkle.', 'The lighthouse approves of this blanket.', 'One more patch of water asleep.', 'Fog, doing its quiet best work.', 'The moon pulls the mist closer.']

do.to: vec(if 'xy' == 'y' then 180.0 else clamp(event.x, 30.0, 360 - 30.0), if 'xy' == 'x' then 380.0 else clamp(event.y, 30.0, 640 - 30.0))
vec(if 'xy' == 'y' then 180.0 else clamp(player_drag__target.x + event.dx, 30.0, 360 - 30.0), if 'xy' == 'x' then 380.0 else clamp(player_drag__target.y + event.dy, 30.0, 640 - 30.0))
vec(player.x + clamp(player_drag__target.x - player.x, -m, m), player.y + clamp(player_drag__target.y - player.y, -m, m))
push(items, {id: pickups__next_id, x: px, y: py, born: now})

children.text: = if status == 'won' then 'THE BAY IS TUCKED IN' else 'THE FOG DRIFTED OFF'
= if status == 'won' then 'The lighthouse approves of this blanket.' else 'The bay is still sparkling. Drift again.'
